status: architecture contract and native integration ledger
principle: One 8 MiB universe, 255 real heads plus NANNET0 at ring position 255; a shared decoder field, not 255 independent models.

layers.name: triadic relation
layers.representation: typed 3-vertex simplex/incidence with phase and strength

layers.name: relation-of-relations
layers.representation: hyperedge IDs as vertices in a higher typed incidence layer

layers.name: field abstraction
layers.representation: ring modes, Laplacian/DFT, gated field mixture

decoder.per_head_adapter: low-rank vector/rotation/gate adapter, not a full copy
decoder.head_phase: theta_h = position phase + content phase + ring angle
decoder.head_gate: phase coherence x evidence confidence x learned gate
decoder.head_readout: q/k/v projection and masked single-head attention
decoder.mixture: out = sum_h g_h * head_value_h; logits mixed with the same gates
decoder.nannet_rule: NANNET0 is a boundary port, never a trainable head and never rotated
decoder.max_dense_attention: 256 x 256 matrix per tile; three-way relations stay sparse

tensors.meaning: typed arrays of field values, not a second geometry
tensors.rule: no dense 255^3 relation tensor; use sparse incidence and tiled dense matrices

gradients.meaning: typed local correction fields, not a hidden host math path
native_mechanisms: straight-through or score-function learning for discrete hyperedges
gradients.open: a full native backward pass for the 255-head decoder field is not implemented

open_gates: multi-head packing and causal masking beyond 16-key tiles
native backward pass for the decoder field
joint training of relation memory and free-running decoder
natural-prose evaluation and matched conventional baseline
non_claims: No 255 independent models; heads share a trunk and field.
NANNET0 is not a trainable head and is not rotated.
No claim that the field beats a matched conventional memory.
The native field mixture is an aggregation seam, not a trained decoder.
